head.t: CROWN-MV trial of Abbott’s Cephea mitral valve system commences
head.x: Abbott has initiated the CROWN-MV pivotal trial evaluating the safety and effectiveness of its investigational Cephea mitral valve system in treating people with symptomatic mitral valve disease who are not candidates for surgery and transcatheter repair.

head.t: Abbott’s transcatheter PVL occlusion device gains US FDA approval
head.x: Abbott has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval for the Amplatzer Paraclose PVL Occluder, a transcatheter device designed to treat paravalvular leak (PVL)—the backflow of blood around a surgical heart valve.

head.t: Abbott to spin off its global Nutrition business as an independent listed company
head.x: Abbott plans a tax-free spin-off of Nutrition (Ensure, Glucerna, PediaSure, Pedialyte, Similac): about $8.5bn sales, 16,000 staff, 14 plants. CEO-designate Daniel Salvadori. Abbott keeps devices, Libre, diagnostics and established medicines (about $42bn).

head.t: Lessons from two decades of carotid stent use: Implications for today’s practice
head.x: This advertorial, sponsored by Abbott, is only intended for readers in the USA. Peter Faries (Mount Sinai Health System, New York, USA) recounts his extensive clinical experience in the field of carotid stenting, highlighting design developments, procedural advances, and pivotal data.
